100521.title: Handlebar component arrangement
guidance: Place 1 EA of Handlebar Tube (Product Number HT-2981) in an assumed assembly jig. Position 1 EA of Stem (Product Number SM-9087) at the central area and check its apparent fit. The attachment geometry and hardware are not specified.
Fit 2 EA of Mountain End Caps (Product Number EC-M092), one at each end of Handlebar Tube (Product Number HT-2981); check that each sits evenly.
Apply 40 IN of purchased LL Grip Tape (Product Number GT-0820) across the two grip zones as an assumed demonstration arrangement; check for loose edges.
